name: Flag icons Bootstrap CkEditor
description: A Bootstrap 5 flag-icon language-switcher block plus a CKEditor 5 flag-icon insert plugin.
project_description:
Bootstrap Integration: Our module is fully compatible with Bootstrap 5, ensuring a consistent and responsive design. 
 Flag Icons: It leverages flag icons to represent each language, making language selection intuitive and visually appealing. 
 User-Friendly Dropdown: The module adds an elegant dropdown button to your website, allowing users to choose their preferred language with ease. 
 Support CkEditor 5 
 Multi-Language Support: Whether your website supports multiple languages or you simply want to provide language options, this module is a valuable addition. 
 Customization: You can customize the display of flag icons, dropdown behavior, and more to match your site's unique style and requirements. 
 
 How It Works: 
 Installation: Simply download and install the module from the Drupal website ( bootstrap flag icons ).

Or via composer

 This module uses cdn from flagicons.lipis.dev 

Best use with bootstrap 5 admin theme 

 - After enabling multiple languages, you can see the block switcher language. place bootstrap flag language with configuration

 - Support ckeditor5

You can insert a flag in ckeditor search with iso, english, french or country code
